rows: Decision: multi-browser (12k lines, Playwright) and, through it, the vnc-auth-capture listener (its desktop launcher attaches to Chromium over CDP through the multi-browser SDK) are the last large TypeScript blocks, and neither can be ported until Rust can drive Chromium. New crate `clis/cdp`: a std-only (no async runtime, no TLS, `serde_json` only) DevTools client: HTTP `/json/*` reads by Content-Length (the DevTools server keeps the socket open), WebSocket upgrade, masked text frames, ping/pong, fragmentation, JSON-RPC request/response matching with events queued, and flattened-session addressing (`call_on`). Not linked into `wf` yet, so the 3.3 MB binary does not grow.
